list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (PlayStation Network via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements)

sources.name: PlayStation Network trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops — this is the last trophy you will ever unlock, so treat it as the finish line, not a goal you chase directly. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, activities, crime and collectibles; A Long Road (100% completion) is the last big gate before it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission. It unlocks automatically as the story opens — just follow the opening objectives.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy that unlocks on its own as you play through the first chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. The finale trophy — unmissable if you finish the game. Around 60 hours of story, per VGC and Push Square.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game Progress > Stats checklist (35 tasks, per KeenGamer). The hardest trophy: it folds story, strangers, activities, collectibles and exploration into one list, so treat it as the endgame cleanup pass, not a separate grind.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime. Vary vehicles and spots so each stunt counts; grind them while exploring for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Sample everything once early — races, fishing, shooting range, arcade, drone races and the rest — and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs clean runs, so learn each range's timing and pattern before chasing the medal.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. The drone handles the same everywhere, so course knowledge is the edge — learn each course once, then race to win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each event only counts once — mix street, off-road and water races while working on Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the tension meter and beat Cal's score — it is a skill check, not a grind.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strands, so pick the eight you enjoy — each strand ends in a final mission with its own trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — each spot is a quiet pause with a view, and the count only climbs when you actually sit down at a new one. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy guides flag: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, GTABase), so meditate there before the story moves on, and keep a manual save before big missions. Guides still disagree on whether a missed spot locks you out, so treat it as missable.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand — the hunt is a tracked target, not random wildlife.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — track full sets, not single cards, and collect while exploring.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to check in at 100 distinct spots — a grind best done while exploring for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are small tasks scattered through activities and the world — they pile up naturally if you play broadly instead of rushing the story.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build 4 stars with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and lay low until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level. Hit three shops in one run with your partner, keep moving, and don't let the cops spot you between stops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 distinct vehicles — variety counts, duplicates don't. Check the vehicle log as you explore.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport by an unusual route rather than the front door — guides read it as an unplanned escape from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. A tank-encounter trophy — face the Rhino tanks and come out on top. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by guides.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, and out before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape — plan the getaway before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck, crack it, grab the cash and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map — the world itself is the checklist. Combine it with WAiNK check-ins and vehicle discovery.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida — each gang's turf has one.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach spot, order the cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet-moment trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. PowerPyx reads it as stealing all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — the precise method is still being confirmed by guides.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Guides tie it to maxing out strength with both Jason and Lucia — a partnership milestone, not a single action.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 criminal actions — your choices across the world add up, so keep playing and it pops.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the retry, not the failure.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange-encounter trophy — the method is still unconfirmed in public guides; it is tied to an odd world event, not a mission.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds — the precise method is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through contacts until the total hits $250,000 — it accumulates across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, food, gear — spending counts everywhere, and it adds up while you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all eight purchasable garages across Leonida — save up, they are the big money sink.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles you own through the app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
